Transit authority hero.d: Sliced breast, shredded iceberg, tomato and mayonnaise on a long roll, wrapped tight in deli paper.

Cheese danish.d: Puff pastry corners folded in over a sweet, lemony filling, thin icing on top.

Transit office jam doughnuts.d: Warmed through and rolled in sugar the minute they come out, so it sticks.

Transit authority rugelach.d: Cream cheese dough rolled up around apricot jam, walnuts and cinnamon sugar, baked crisp at the ends.

Mr Green's honey lemon whisky toddy.d: Whisky, honey, lemon and fresh ginger, topped up with boiling water, a cinnamon stick to stir.
